influences.name: Peter Sellars
influences.context: Peter wanted me to write an opera for him

influences.name: Simone Weil
influences.context: In my teens, when I first started to read Simone Weil, I felt that she had experienced so much more than I had at that point

influences.name: Amin Maalouf
influences.context: Following their fruitful collaborations with L'amour de loin and Adriana Mater, Maalouf became Saariaho's chosen librettist for La Passion de Simone too

influences.name: Dawn Upshaw
influences.context: While I was at work with the solo part, I had in mind all that experience I had gained working with Dawn's smooth registers in L'amour de loin

influences.name: Philippe Jaroussky
influences.context: we collaborated closely with Philippe Jaroussky on Only the Sound Remains (2015). For example, he suggested setting the first part in the lower registers and saving the higher ones for the second part

influences.name: Brian Ferneyhough
influences.context: She continued her training in Freiburg with the composers Brian Ferneyhough and Klaus Huber

influences.name: Klaus Huber
influences.context: She continued her training in Freiburg with the composers Brian Ferneyhough and Klaus Huber

influences.name: Paavo Heininen
influences.context: studied with Paavo Heininen at the Sibelius Academy

influences.name: spectralist composers
influences.context: her study of the French spectralist composers, made electronic and computer-generated music a constant element in her music

influences.name: Olivier Messiaen
influences.context: The definitive push came with a Peter Sellers production of Olivier Messiaen's Saint François d'Assise, performed at the Salzburg Festival, which she described as 'liberating,' and 'a sign' that she could venture into the opera genre.
